nodes.title: 1 · Install FRAME Nodes
widgets_values:
# Required custom node: FRAME Nodes
Available in ComfyUI Manager / Comfy Registry as **frame-nodes**.
Use **Install Missing Custom Nodes**, then restart ComfyUI.
Source: https://github.com/Coffmeteor/ComfyUI-FRAME

nodes.title: 2 · Configure your local recipe
widgets_values:
# Configure once on desktop
Click **Configure models & LoRAs**. Select your Krea2 model, text encoder and VAE.
Add your own LoRA groups, strengths and trigger words; optionally import UTF-8 .txt wildcards.
Save, then click **Open generated workflow / 打开已生成工作流**.

nodes.title: 3 · Generate on desktop or phone
widgets_values:
# Prompt sources + simple switches
Choose Manual, FRAME Original/Rewrite (full library or latest update), or a local library.
Use **Reuse current** to keep a prompt; **Random each generation** draws another.
ComfyLink: restart while idle, upload the generated workflow, then sync on your phone.
